name: Coherence Threshold
description: Minimum coherence level required for election acceptance

name: Allow Backtracking
description: Whether ARIA can revise previous decisions

name: User Influence Weight
description: How much user preferences influence ARIA's decisions

name: Coherence Decay Rate
description: Rate at which coherence naturally degrades

name: Enable Manifestation
description: Whether ARIA decisions produce real-world output

name: Prediction Depth
description: How many elections ahead to simulate
